name: show_item
description: Shows one item from the business's catalog on the caller's screen. It exists only in the Products & Pricing stage, which the workflow opens only when display_enabled is true: on a phone call the caller has no screen. Call it once for the item the caller asked about, with the id copied from catalog. Do not announce it and do not wait for it before speaking: say what the item is and what it costs in one sentence, the screen carries the rest.

item_id.description: The id of the item to show, copied exactly from catalog. Never an id that is not in the list.
